{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssue2283",
  "test_code": "using System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing FluentAssertions;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2283\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_DoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzer()\n    {\n        var frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var mpRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        var references = frameworkRefs.Concat(mpRefs).ToImmutableArray();\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\"\"\";\n\n        var libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        emitResult.Success.Should().BeTrue(string.Join(\"\\n\", emitResult.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n\n        var libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray().ToImmutableArray());\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)] public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        var appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        // Test Analyzer\n        var analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        analyzerDiagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n\n        // Test Generator\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        var runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        runResult.Results.Should().AllSatisfy(r => r.Exception.Should().BeNull());\n        generatorDiagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n        runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).Should().NotBeEmpty();\n    }\n}\n"
}
